module: "Delivery > Veh Offers" career debug tab. 'Vehicle Offer Debug' window listing, per delivery facility, the non-expired vehicle/trailer offers (career_modules_delivery_vehicleOfferManager). The entry '> Available vehicle/trailer per facility' prints the number of offers per unlock level (1 to 5) via isVehicleTagUnlocked.

onCareerActivated.desc: Hook: stores the delivery modules and parcelDebug.

drawDebugFunctions.desc: Entries '> Available vehicle per facility' and '> Available trailer per facility': count the non-expired offers per level and print the sorted result.

drawDebugMenu.desc: Draws the 'Vehicle Offer Debug' window: delivery time, facility choice (all, auto or id) and offer tables.
